text.en: Appa bought a new calendar. Amma found July missing! “Don't worry, July and January look the same,” said Dadi, and they played a calendar game.

A clock has an hour hand and a minute hand. The short hand shows hours and the long hand shows minutes.
A clock with hands is an analog clock. A clock that shows time in digits is a digital clock.
When the minute hand is on 12 and the hour hand on 3, it is 3 o'clock.
From one number to the next on the clock is 5 minutes. 12 full of five-minute steps makes 60 minutes in an hour.
Write the time taken by looking at the start and end positions of the hands.
Time can also be measured with a sand clock. You can make one with two small bottles and fine sand, in front of an adult.
List what you can do in 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes.

problem.en: The hour hand is on 3 and the minute hand on 12. What time?

prompt.en: What is the difference between analog and digital clocks?

points.en: Short hand for hours, long for minutes.
